visits.title: Visits
visits.description: Recorded garden check-ins count toward these milestones. Event RSVPs do not count as visits.
visits.milestone: {count, plural, one {# garden visit} other {# garden visits}}

harvests.title: Harvests
harvests.description: Each journal entry you author at the harvest stage counts as one harvest, regardless of its weight.
harvests.milestone: {count, plural, one {# harvest recorded} other {# harvests recorded}}

photos.title: Journal photos
photos.description: Each photo currently attached to a journal entry you author counts toward these milestones.
photos.milestone: {count, plural, one {# journal photo} other {# journal photos}}

achievements.nextBody: Open a garden page to check in when you visit. If you have access to a bed's journal, add your harvests and photos there. Progress reflects your current records across all time; editing or removing entries can change it.
